[Unit]

Wants=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/ifup eth1
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/ifup eth2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl restart [REDACTED].service
